headline: A 1999 executive order set up a federal task force focused on economic development along the US Southwest border.
what_it_does: This order created a task force made up of several federal agencies. Based on its title, the group was meant to look at economic development in communities along the Southwest border with Mexico. No summary was provided, so the task force's specific duties, members, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Several agencies were directed to take part in a shared task force on Southwest border economic development.
Their local economies were the focus of the task force's work, though the specific effects are not stated in the available material.
